$comment: UX invariants for the Playwright-MCP autonomous UAT goal-loop (P4.T14). Each invariant encodes one robustness property; the loop drives the UI, observes, and asserts these. `check` describes the observable assertion; `origin` links back to the Phase-1 fix that must hold.

invariants.title: Renderer visible iff a render artifact exists
invariants.check: After a turn that produces NO renderable artifact, the renderer drawer is not left open showing 'No rendered content yet'. After a turn that DOES produce an artifact, the drawer is open and shows the render.

invariants.title: No leftover INSPECTOR placeholder when items exist
invariants.check: When an nle-timeline renders with at least one clip or caption cue, the inspector shows metadata (SELECTION/ACTIVE SENTENCE), NOT the 'Select an item on the timeline to view its details' placeholder.
signals: text 'Select an item on the timeline'

invariants.title: Exactly one render block per artifact
invariants.check: A single completed render produces exactly one render history entry for its manifest key (no duplicate render blocks for the same artifact within a turn).

invariants.title: Working/compose animation shows during every render
invariants.check: While the Render Agent is composing (hook or dispatch path), the renderer shows the 'Rendering…' animation until the manifest arrives.

invariants.title: Drawer opens, composes, then renders (in order)
invariants.check: For a job-completion auto-render on the active session: the request bubble appears immediately, the working animation runs, the renderer drawer opens and composes, then the final render appears — in that order (no abrupt dump).
signals: order of: user bubble, working indicator, drawer open, render block

invariants.title: No console errors during a turn
invariants.check: No uncaught errors or 'Error in input stream' banners appear in the transcript or browser console during a normal turn.

uat_scenarios.$comment: Representative harvested flows to exercise the invariants. Selected by category from datasets/harvested/harvested.json.

loop.goal_state: all selected scenarios pass all their invariants in a single sweep
loop.escalate_when: an invariant requires a subjective UX decision (ambiguous intended behavior)
